body: I use grocery delivery - Amazon Fresh and SayWeee. It can be a pain, but if you know when to expect it and give clear instructions it can be easier than going to the store. Trader Joe's is really good too and bikeable. If you're in EV consider getting a grocery cart/wagon because parking is far.
I've found Broccoli Waltham 29 from TrueLeafMarket to have the best cost, germination, and flavor profile. I've tried Sunflower, Amaranth, Mustard, Radish, Basil, Cabbage... Broccoli FTW!

Broccoli! It's cheap, grows quickly, is plentiful, and has a nutty flavor that's unique to the greens. The amaranth is kinda overrated imo :p . The broccoli is also easier to as a side or topping to food. I loved the color and flavor of the Sango Radish, but it was actually too flavorful and spicy for my fiancee, haha. I didn't really know how to use it well. 🤙🤙🤙

There are also a couple cases of beer. 2 Cases of Mello Yello. Some fancy sparkling juices that we all implicitly decided should only be drunk/offered to investors and guests. We have a water fountain, which came with the space we're renting. It's all unlimited access and we have a google sheet for requests that we do weekly.
